title: Global-classes diff-PUT body — add one class, modify one, delete one, with the FULL final order array (PUT /design/classes, 10-rest-api.md §4.2)
_comment: WP-Q01 design fixture. Carries the EXACT diff-PUT request body (10-rest-api.md §4.2 NORMATIVE shape) in `settings` (the only free-form object slot in the locked envelope, 14-fixtures-harness.md §2 — design bodies have no dedicated key, and `settings` is type:object with no further constraint). NORMATIVE invariants encoded: (1) `changes.{added,deleted,modified}` enumerate touched ids; `changes.order:true` flags a reorder. (2) `items` contains ONLY the touched ids (added + modified) — g-newcard (added) + g-existinghero (modified) — NEVER the full collection, NEVER the deleted id (g-oldpromo). (3) top-level `order` is the FULL final id list = existing − deleted + added, consistent or the handler returns INVALID_ORDER (§4.2, ...:366-372). (4) deletion is EXPLICIT via changes.deleted (omitting does NOT delete). (5) budget: count(existing) − deleted + added ≤ MAX 1000 ([R5]/SUMMARY C2, admin-only cap elementor_global_classes_update_class, S05/C4). Each item's variants use TYPED prop envelopes ([R8]). expect.valid:true is the STRUCTURAL validity of the body shape (this is NOT a tree dry_run — kind:design fixtures are not run through Validator::dry_run; the PHP loader gates by `requires` and the design-write suite asserts the diff body against the §4.2 contract).
